mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 9.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both industrial production and residential construction activity indicates a broad-based slowdown in the real economy, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO and HOUST both decline, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a rolling regression.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases real interest rates, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment growth above 150,000 jobs per month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below $375 billion signals a contraction in consumer spending, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0), a simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.5%) signals a dual shock to the economy (supply and labor), causing a sharp decline in equity valuations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p>0.05) in a rolling regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized growth signals robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% annualized, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
